name: Samosa
full_name: Aloo samosa, deep-fried (potato and pea filling in a maida crust)
basis: A typical 80 g halwai samosa: about 30 g maida crust, 35 g spiced potato and peas, and 12-15 g of absorbed oil. Ingredient values from IFCT 2017; 80 g comes to about 240 kcal.

name: Pyaz kachori
full_name: Onion kachori, deep-fried (spiced onion filling in a flaky maida crust)
basis: A typical 70 g Jodhpur-style kachori: maida crust with ghee, spiced onion and besan filling, and about 15 g of absorbed oil. Ingredient values from IFCT 2017; one comes to about 260 kcal.

name: Dal kachori
basis: A typical 60 g khasta kachori with a spiced moong dal filling and about 12 g of absorbed oil; IFCT 2017 ingredient values. One comes to about 230 kcal.

name: Kadhi
full_name: Punjabi or Rajasthani kadhi: curd and besan curry with a tadka, without pakoras
basis: Per 100 g: about 40 g curd, 5 g besan, 3 g oil or ghee in the tadka, the rest water. IFCT 2017 ingredient values.

name: Kadhi pakora
basis: Kadhi with about 20 g of fried besan pakoras per 100 g; IFCT 2017 ingredient values.

name: Aloo tikki
basis: A 60 g potato patty with a little besan or bread binder, shallow-fried in about 5 g of oil; IFCT 2017 and USDA potato values.

name: Vada pav
full_name: Batata vada in a pav with chutneys
basis: One 140 g vada pav: a 40 g pav and a 90 g besan-coated potato vada with about 10 g of absorbed oil, plus chutneys. About 295 kcal each.

name: Pani puri
full_name: Pani puri with potato and chana filling
basis: One 20 g puri with its potato and chana filling and some pani; the puri itself holds most of the oil. Six come to about 215 kcal.

name: Bhel puri
full_name: Bhel puri: puffed rice, sev, papdi, potato, onion and chutneys
basis: A 150 g plate: about 40 g murmura, 15 g sev and papdi, 30 g potato, onion, tomato and sweet and green chutneys. About 255 kcal a plate.

name: Sev puri
full_name: Sev puri: papdi topped with potato, chutneys and sev
basis: Six papdi with potato, chutneys and sev, about 130 g; the fried papdi and sev carry most of the calories.

name: Bhatura
basis: One 70 g bhatura: maida dough with curd, and about 12 g of absorbed oil. About 240 kcal each.

name: Veg momos, steamed
basis: One 25 g steamed momo: a thin maida wrapper with cabbage, carrot and onion filling and a little oil. About 40 kcal each.

name: Jalebi
full_name: Jalebi, fried and soaked in sugar syrup
basis: One 30 g piece: fried maida batter soaked in sugar syrup. About 120 kcal each.

name: Gulab jamun
basis: One 45 g piece with its syrup: khoya and maida dough fried in ghee or oil. About 150 kcal each.

name: Pakora
full_name: Onion or mixed vegetable pakoras (bhajiya), deep-fried
basis: One 20 g fritter of besan batter with onion or vegetables and about 3 g of absorbed oil. About 60 kcal each.

name: Dahi vada
basis: One 100 g serving: an urad dal vada soaked and topped with curd and sweet chutney. About 150 kcal each.

name: Instant noodles
full_name: Instant masala noodles, cooked with the tastemaker
basis: One 70 g pack (about 310 kcal) cooked to about 230 g; pack label values.

name: Kulcha
full_name: Plain kulcha, leavened maida flatbread cooked on a tawa or in a tandoor
basis: One 75 g kulcha: maida dough with curd and a little oil or butter. IFCT 2017 ingredient values; about 210 kcal each.
